hits.snippet: by [Michael Watkins](https://www.imd.org/ibyimd/iauthors/michael-watkins/) Published July 9, 2026 in [Talent](https://www.imd.org/ibyimd/category/talent/) • 8 min read Materials science multinational, Dow Inc, announced a leadership shakeup in April 2026, naming chief operating officer Karen Carter as its new chief executive. A Dow veteran of more than 30 years, Carter became CEO on July 1, replacing Jim Fitterling who has moved to the role of executive chairman. Fitterling has helmed Dow through turbulent conditions since 2018, including strong economic headwinds that saw the company announce a sweeping $2 billion restructuring in January. As Carter takes up the reins, the stakes are vertiginous. While Fitterling has publicly welcomed her into the top job – calling her appointment the product of a “deliberate, multi-year succession process,” and promising “continuity and strong execution” – the road ahead is steep.
